summary: Vir Biotechnology filed a routine 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing that the FDA granted Fast Track designation to VIR-5500, a PSMA-targeted PRO-XTEN dual-masked T-cell engager, for late-line metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved; the filing solely attaches a press release as Exhibit 99.1. VIR-5500 is co-developed with Astellas Pharma under a global strategic collaboration, with pivotal Phase 3 development targeted for 2027. No deal terms, advisors, regulatory clocks, or arbitrage angles apply; this is a clinical/regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
